environment.description: Linux; frozen CW-15 lifecycle candidate; in-repository production composition and deterministic runtime boundary fixtures; no external OMP or reboot claims

items.evidence: Lifecycle runtime exercises detach while peer processes remain alive, log drain continues, and active review remains scheduled under the same durable RunIdentity.
Restart reconciliation observes exact task/revision/run and process incarnation, distinguishes alive/dead/unknown, fails closed on drift, and never replays an unknown command outcome.
Injected review/model errors hold decision emission while the run and raw observation path continue, with combined Pause authority enforced at the production binding.

Concurrent takeover, duplicate takeover, handoff, command final-claim, shutdown, and review traces verify a monotonic generation fence, durable reopen ordering, zero replay, and claim-as-submission linearization through the G3 production port.

Shutdown stops each managed process at most once, reports survivors without implicit force, and completes only after exact current RunIdentity observation confirms full termination; wrong, malformed, missing, or exceptional observations remain unconfirmed.
Boot-change and metadata-failure traces keep automation latched until explicit durable confirmation; recreated coordinators preserve the fail-closed state and reject peer/control drift.
